_what: What kind of state a choice value is, so a row that moves to a list with different choices keeps its meaning (src/choice-mapping.mjs). A kind is a row here: `id`, a `label`, and `names`, the words that name it when a choice field does not say (compared whole, case and spacing ignored). A choice field may say its own kinds with `kinds: { <choice>: <kind id> }`; that always wins over the names. A value moves to the target field's choice of the same kind: the same name when the target has several of that kind, otherwise the first of that kind in the target's order. A value whose kind the target does not have goes to the target's `starts` value, or is left empty when it has none, and the move says so. A new kind is a row here.
